claims.text: Each slide becomes a section starting with <!-- Slide number: N -->, title heading, text, table or chart data and notes
Hidden slide 8 with superseded figures was converted with no hidden mark
Section slide became an empty heading; two identical Results headings; picture-only slide had no title
Three bullet levels came through as plain flush-left lines with no markers
Speaker notes came through under ### Notes:
Native chart became ### Chart: heading and a table July 4.2, August 5.1, September 7.8; axis title Month missing
Picture-only slide: alt text plus an image file name that does not exist in the Markdown; values in the picture lost
Table converted intact; units text box became a separate line after it
Two side-by-side text boxes read left to right although the right one was added first
LLMiser accepts .pptx up to 15 MB; .ppt not supported
Text recognition applies to uploaded images, scanned PDF pages and images inside a ZIP, not pictures inside a deck
claims.source: frontend/lib/formats.js OCR pool; backendZ ocr_available; F-M05 picture slide
